notes: Non-discriminating: contract test, compile, real font families, no Latin-only display font on Japanese, emoji box size, reduced-motion loops and 'preview produced' passed for every run with or without the skill. Opus already keeps names/callbacks intact and self-previews.

Discriminating: Japanese bold weight (2/3 baselines requested Regular -> thin CJK), Unicode 13+ tofu emoji (deep-sea baseline kept the original 🪙 coin, which Roblox draws as a box), text contrast (2/3 baselines had a low-contrast label), hue variety (moodboard baseline stayed within 3 hue families).
Cost: with-skill runs took ~4% longer and ~10% more tokens (reading references, spec + style board + skin test).

Qualitative (Studio screenshots studio-home.png / studio-shop.png in every run): baselines are strong and sometimes richer in illustration (ennichi baseline: goldfish tub, candy apples, ramune; moodboard baseline: drawn shop icons). With-skill runs converge on one formula - tilted lemon pill CTA with a breathing halo and sticker type - across all three motifs: homogenisation risk inherited from the Pop Rink example.

With-skill titles sit under Roblox's top-left core buttons in 2/3 runs (IgnoreGuiInset); the ennichi baseline explicitly reserved the top-bar inset. The skill does not mention the topbar safe area yet.
Grader caveat: contrast and variety are measured on the Lune mock (no layout engine); rects under UIListLayout/ScrollingFrame fall back to ancestor fills.
